title: Record every payment as a ledger of provider events
description: A payment is now a record in the back office from the moment the buyer presses a payment button: what is being paid for, by whom, for how much, and every event the provider reported about it. Invoices, events, the shop and the marketplace all pay through it, and the outcome is shown on one result page at `/{workspace}/payments/{reference}` that survives a refresh, a closed tab and a forwarded link. The browser return and the provider's webhook settle through the same ledger, so a payment confirmed after the tab was closed is still recorded and a notification that arrives twice is counted once. A captured payment is booked in the ERP from its own record, with sale order, invoice and invoice payment built together, and a booking that cannot run waits under Portal › Payments › Payments to resolve with the reason and a retry. A payment left open is followed up with its provider until the provider gives its final answer, for up to 30 days past its deadline; one still without an answer then, or whose provider is never told anything, as Paybox and Up2Pay can be, is listed as having no answer for finance to check, with the reason on its session. A Stripe bank transfer stays open for 14 days, as the payer is told with its bank details, and is then cancelled at Stripe, part of it received or not. Paying an invoice withdraws the open bank transfers it no longer needs, and a transfer the payer has already funded in part must be completed, or run out its 14 days, before the invoice is paid another way. Refunds and disputes are handled at the provider and booked in the ERP by hand; the portal does not track them. From the ERP, a person can record a capture, always for the full amount due, or a cancellation seen in the provider's back office, retry any payment task, and resolve, with the reason, a payment settled outside the portal: a purchase that could not be delivered, more captured than the payment was for, or a booking the registration could not make. The previous payment flow is removed with its addresses under `/api/payment/`, so a payment begun on an earlier release is not completed by this one. Upgrading needs the per-tenant steps in the runbook at https://github.com/axelor/goovee/blob/main/migrations/payments.md.
